title: Describe a Clear Outdoor Route

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Aim for 90–120 seconds; this is a suggested target, not a minimum. Use at least six lesson words. To pass review, your answer’s transcript must contain at least 100 words, and the required audio and review evidence must be available. The reference and its audio are short language examples, not full-length demonstrations; create your own answer.
prompt: Describe a fictional outdoor walk for a group. Say where people meet, explain two landmarks, and describe what they should do if the planned path is closed. Aim to speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would arrange a short walk for friends near a stream. We would meet beside a blue clock at ten, because that landmark is easy to recognize. First we would follow a wide path east toward the water. After the bridge, we would go along the edge of a field and stop at a shelter. I would check a local notice before we leave. If the narrow trail is muddy, we would use a wider route instead. I would tell everyone the name of the second meeting place and give them the guide's number. Someone could ask for help without guessing which way to go. We would take our time and stay together.
